translation:
<ins>Head (頭部)</ins>
From below the hairline of the nape to the back, the bone is two and a half cun long. (From the posterior hairline to the three segments of the nape bone at Dazhui (大椎).)
[Comment] The folding method for the head: from the anterior hairline to the posterior hairline, fold it as one chi and two cun. If the hairline is not clear, then take the midpoint between the eyebrows, going straight up and back to the Dazhu (大杼) bone, and fold it as one chi and eight cun; this is the straight cun.
